## Core Technical Stack
- AI & Generative AI: LLM applications, chatbots, ElevenLabs voice assistants, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, document data extraction
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL
- Frontend: React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Vite
- Backend & Cloud: Node.js, FastAPI, Flask, Express.js, Elysia (Bun), AWS (ECS, ALB, EC2, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, HealthLake), Docker, SST, REST APIs, Microservices
- Databases & Caching: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis
- Integration & Security: SSO (Auth0 / Okta), OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC, MFA, HIPAA, HL7 FHIR
